nodes.label: Acronym Casing Rule
nodes.rationale: All-caps acronyms make identifiers hard to read or reason about without documentation; getHttpUrl() beats getHTTPURL(). Leading acronyms in fields/params go fully lowercase (url), non-leading ones capitalize only the first letter (baseUrl).

nodes.label: Locator Method Postfix
nodes.rationale: Methods are named as camelCase actions (changeSorting, changeGrouping); 'change' is preferred over 'apply', and any method returning a locator carries the 'Locator' postfix so its return type is obvious at the call site.

nodes.label: verify Prefix for Assertions
nodes.rationale: Prefixing assertion methods with 'verify' improves readability and makes assertions greppable across the suite.

nodes.label: Test File Naming (_test suffix)
nodes.rationale: Test files use camelCase and a mandatory _test ending so the runner and humans can identify them unambiguously.

nodes.label: Page Object Pattern
nodes.rationale: Hard-coded locators inside a test are bad practice; every locator must live inside a CodeceptJS Page Object so selector churn is fixed in one place.

nodes.label: Stable Locator Selection
nodes.rationale: Ideally every interactive element carries a dedicated data-qa attribute; id, classname and text are acceptable fallbacks, and XPath should stay small.

nodes.label: Locator Preference: locate() > CSS > XPath
nodes.rationale: The locate() builder is first priority, CSS second, XPath only as a last resort because it is the most brittle.

nodes.label: In-Test Assertions
nodes.rationale: CodeceptJS assertions (I.seeElement, I.dontSeeElement, I.seeInCurrentUrl) may be used inline in a test; non-CodeceptJS assertions only when they cannot live anywhere else.

nodes.label: Data Provider for Data-Driven Tests
nodes.rationale: When the same scenario runs with different data, a Data Provider cuts code volume and raises maintainability; a comment must explain why it was used.

nodes.label: One Feature Per Test File
nodes.rationale: Splitting one feature per file lets CodeceptJS distribute tests across workers so parallel execution is more effective; multiple features share a file only when they need common BeforeSteps.

nodes.label: Scenario Title Template
nodes.rationale: Titles follow {TEST_CASE_ID} Title {annotation} and embed the original TMT test case ID so a case can be found by searching the suite.

nodes.label: Test Group Annotations
nodes.rationale: Group annotations are appended at the end of the test title (e.g. @pmm-pre-update) so runs can be selected by tag.

nodes.label: Getting Started Setup
nodes.rationale: Node.js 12+ with npx, npm ci, playwright driver install-deps, then npx codeceptjs def pr.codecept.js to build TS definitions.

nodes.label: Local PMM Server Compose Configurations
nodes.rationale: Documented variants: default docker-compose, ami-db-setup, mongodb-ssl, mongo-replica, mysql-ssl and postgresql-ssl.

nodes.label: PMM_UI_URL Remote Server Override
nodes.rationale: Tests target a remote PMM instance by setting PMM_UI_URL in the environment or a .env file instead of editing config.

nodes.label: Backup Management MongoDB Environment Setup
nodes.rationale: setup-replica-and-pbm-local.sh launches PMM Server, PMM Client and a 3-node Percona MongoDB replica set with PBM.

nodes.label: Parallel Test Execution
nodes.rationale: codeceptjs run-multiple parallel splits the suite into worker chunks, each producing its own parallel_chunkN report directory.

nodes.label: Allure Reporting
nodes.rationale: Either a dockerised allure server on port 5252 (no extra requirements) or allure-commandline, which needs Java 8+.

nodes.label: CodeceptJS CLI Arguments
nodes.rationale: --steps prints step-by-step output, --debug adds detail, --verbose the most, --grep selects tests by tag.

nodes.label: Test Tag Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Tags map tests onto CI jobs and functional areas (@backup, @dashboards, @qan, @settings, @stt, @instances, @inventory, upgrade phases, FB-only variants); @pmm-ami, @not-ui-pipeline and @not-pr-pipeline are marked legacy/deprecated.

nodes.label: Upgrade Tag Phases
nodes.rationale: @pre-upgrade runs before and @post-upgrade after a docker upgrade, with @post-client-upgrade gated on the pmm-client update inside the pmm-upgrade job.

nodes.label: Custom readyz Healthcheck Override
nodes.rationale: The stock image healthcheck gives up before a cold PMM Server answers /v1/server/readyz, which aborts `up` for the service_healthy dependents; the override adds a 60s start_period with 10 retries.

nodes.label: Single-File ClickHouse Config Mounts
nodes.rationale: access-control.xml and datasource-user.xml are mounted as single read-only files rather than directories because the image entrypoint writes its own users.d/default-user.xml on start and fails if that directory is read-only.

nodes.label: PMM_DISABLE_BUILTIN_CLICKHOUSE Switch
nodes.rationale: Disables the bundled ClickHouse so PMM_CLICKHOUSE_ADDR/DATASOURCE point at the external server, with a separate grafana datasource user from the pmm write user.

nodes.label: Self-Signed CA and Client Certificate Generation
nodes.rationale: openssl builds a CA plus server and client key pairs; server files are chowned to uid 26 (postgres in the Percona image) at 0600 and client files to uid 1000 so both containers can read only what they own.
nodes.norm_label: self-signed ca and client certificate generation

nodes.label: external-postgres-ssl Container
nodes.rationale: Started with ssl=on and explicit ca/cert/key files, pg_stat_statements preloaded with track=all, and max_connections=1000.

nodes.label: pmm-server-external-postgres-ssl Container
nodes.rationale: Both the PMM_POSTGRES_* and GF_DATABASE_* paths are pointed at the same external DB in verify-ca mode, so Grafana and PMM each validate the CA independently.

nodes.label: PMM_DISABLE_BUILTIN_POSTGRES Switch
nodes.rationale: Turns off the bundled PostgreSQL so PMM and Grafana both store state in the external grafana database.

nodes.label: Idempotent Teardown Before Provisioning
nodes.rationale: Both playbooks force-remove all four external-postgres containers and both named volumes with ignore_errors before starting, so a re-run never inherits state from the other variant.

nodes.label: Integrated Alerting Test Guide
nodes.rationale: Requires PMM Server 2.19.0 or higher.

nodes.label: Mailosaur Email Verification Credentials
nodes.rationale: MAILOSAUR_API_KEY, MAILOSAUR_SERVER_ID and MAILOSAUR_SMTP_PASSWORD must be present in the environment for email-channel alert assertions.

nodes.label: Authenticated Self-Signed SSL Webhook Receiver
nodes.rationale: docker-compose-webhook.yml serves https://webhookd:8080/alert with alert|alert basic auth and a self-signed CA; fired alerts land in testdata/ia/scripts/alert.txt. Tests start the webhook themselves, so manual startup is only for debugging.

nodes.label: pmm2-ui-tests Jenkins Job
nodes.rationale: Integrated Alerting runs with tag @fb-alerting, 'run tagged day' yes, and no PMM clients required.
